verdict.rationale: Drata documents automated monitoring tests that run against connected systems: a Monitoring Tests API, an "Understanding Monitoring" guide, Connections docs, and a stated ability to "monitor controls, evidence, and personnel." The endpoint agent checks security configurations on devices, and a community report confirms that noncompliant users show up in the Drata dashboard, which corroborates that failures surface outside the audit cycle. Missing for 10: any evidence of test frequency or cadence showing failures surface within hours, in-depth docs on how tests evaluate controls (most items are page titles only), and independent hands-on corroboration of alerting latency.
